source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 4: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Upar aur neeche dono polynomials ki degree 2 hai. Degree barabar ho to bhi fraction improper hai, is liye pehle divide karna zaroori hai.
Division ke baad jo remainder fraction bachega, us ka denominator \(x^2 - 6x - 7\) do alag linear factors mein toot jata hai, yani Case-I.
Plan: divide, factorise, roots rakh kar \(A\), \(B\), phir integral.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x^2 - 12x - 21}{x^2 - 6x - 7}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: degrees barabar hain, is liye pehle division, phir remainder par partial fractions (Case-I). Yaad rakhiye: partial fractions sirf proper fraction ke hote hain.

Divide karein
\[x^2 - 12x - 21 = 1\cdot(x^2 - 6x - 7) + (-6x - 14)\]
\[\dfrac{x^2 - 12x - 21}{x^2 - 6x - 7} = 1 + \dfrac{-6x - 14}{x^2 - 6x - 7}\]
Kyun: Dono ka leading term \(x^2\) hai, is liye quotient sirf 1 hai. Remainder: \((x^2 - 12x - 21) - (x^2 - 6x - 7) = -6x - 14\).
Dhyan dein: Minus karte waqt \(-(-7) = +7\) hota hai: \(-21 + 7 = -14\).

Factorise kar ke torein
\[x^2 - 6x - 7 = (x - 7)(x + 1)\]
\[\dfrac{-6x - 14}{(x - 7)(x + 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 7} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1}\]
\[-6x - 14 = A(x + 1) + B(x - 7) \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers jin ka product \(-7\) aur jama \(-6\) ho: \(-7\) aur \(1\). Phir har linear factor ke neeche ek constant, aur denominator se multiply kar ke fractions khatam.

Integral lein
\[\int \left(1 - \dfrac{7}{x - 7} + \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\right)dx\]
\[= x - 7\ln|x - 7| + \ln|x + 1| + c\]
Kyun: Quotient 1 ka integral \(x\); har linear fraction ka integral \(\ln\), constant ke saath. Division wala quotient bhool jana bohat aam ghalti hai, us ka integral bhi jawab ka hissa hai.

Tasdeeq
\[-\dfrac{7}{x - 7} + \dfrac{1}{x + 1} = \dfrac{-7x - 7 + x - 7}{(x - 7)(x + 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{-6x - 14}{x^2 - 6x - 7} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Partial fractions wapas jama kiye to remainder wala fraction mil gaya; us mein 1 jama karein to asal integrand. Jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 301) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (iv) hai: \(x - 7\ln|x - 7| + \ln|x + 1| + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
